lines.zh: 我的脚步落在你身后三格处
lines.en: My steps land three blocks behind you, always.
I do not run; I only keep walking.

lines.zh: 落叶在我脚下没有声音
lines.en: Leaves make no sound beneath my feet.

lines.zh: 每棵树后我都换一次方向
lines.en: I change direction behind every tree.

lines.zh: 你听见的呼吸不是你的
lines.en: The breathing you hear is not your own.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四步我才热身
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four steps, and I am only warm.
I walk inside your footprints, one after another.
The grass parts for me, then slowly closes.
The deeper the night, the steadier my pace.

lines.zh: 你回头时我正好在树下
lines.en: I am beneath the tree exactly when you turn.
A hundred plates of armor keep the wind off me.
I follow the edge of your torchlight.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，像焦黑的柱子
lines.en: I stand motionless, a charred pillar among the pines.

lines.zh: 夜风穿过我，像穿过空屋
lines.en: Night wind passes through me like an empty house.
I am counting the breaths inside your tent.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四次心跳，我数过了
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four heartbeats; I counted them all.

lines.zh: 我的甲片在暗处微微发烫
lines.en: My armor plates grow faintly warm in the dark.
When there is no firelight, my eyes stay open.
The shadows shift; I do not.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的早晨
lines.en: I am waiting for a morning that will not come.

lines.zh: 土里的虫也停下了叫声
lines.en: Even the worms in the soil have stopped their noise.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向你营地的方向
lines.en: I turn my face toward your camp.
The wind carries iron and sweat.
Slowly I close my hands, then open them.
The distant water gives no reflection of me.
I listen to the sound of you sharpening your blade.

lines.zh: 你看我时，我的眼睛更黑了
lines.en: When you look at me, my eyes grow darker.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我客气地请求
lines.en: Do not look away; I ask this politely.

lines.zh: 我的脸只有轮廓，没有五官
lines.en: My face has only an outline, no features.

lines.zh: 我已经数清你睫毛的根数
lines.en: I have counted every lash on your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔缩了一下，我看见了
lines.en: Your pupils narrowed once; I saw it.
I do not blink, and neither must you.
You look lovely holding that sword up.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里看见我自己
lines.en: In your eyes I see myself standing there.
Look up; I am still right here.
I heard your breath catch, just once.

lines.zh: 隔着雾我也认得你的脸
lines.en: Even through the fog I know your face.
I lean my head over, and yours leans too.
The shadow behind you is shorter than I am.
Just keep looking at me; do not turn around.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在门框上，看你
lines.en: I lean my head on the doorframe and watch you.

lines.zh: 你眨眼那一下，我挪近了
lines.en: You blinked once, and I moved closer.

lines.zh: 你在玻璃里找我，我就在
lines.en: You look for me in the glass, and I am there.
Do not cover your eyes. It will not help.

lines.zh: 你的灯只照亮我身后那片黑
lines.en: Your lamp only lights the dark behind me.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只跟着你转头
lines.en: I make no sound, I just turn when you turn.
Your sword only scrapes off some dust.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，慢慢砍
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health; keep swinging.
It hurts, but the pain is far away.

lines.zh: 百层护甲替我挡了九成
lines.en: A hundred armor took nine tenths of it.
That blow only makes me want you more.
That dull sound you heard was my plating.
I step back half a pace to see you better.

lines.zh: 伤口会合上，别高兴太早
lines.en: The wound will close; do not celebrate.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我看得清楚
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; I see it clearly.
Keep cutting; I am not yet serious.
No meal you carry could move me.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我只看着你
lines.en: You raise the bread; I only look at you.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是一直在追
lines.en: I am not hungry; I only keep chasing.

lines.zh: 金苹果的光照不进我眼睛
lines.en: Golden apple light never reaches my eyes.

lines.zh: 收起你的诱饵，那不管用
lines.en: Put away your bait; it will not work.

lines.zh: 我吃的是距离，不是麦子
lines.en: What I eat is distance, not wheat.
The thing in your hand is trembling.
I come closer, and not for food.
Your heartbeat smells better than bread.
Do not feed me; I cannot be filled.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，像撞一堵冷墙
lines.en: You collide with me like a cold wall.

lines.zh: 我的甲片没有一丝温度
lines.en: There is no warmth at all in my plates.

lines.zh: 你退开三步，我上前一步
lines.en: You step back three paces; I take one.
One touch, and you will remember it.

lines.zh: 我的手指比你想的更硬
lines.en: My fingers are harder than you imagine.
Do not come closer; I take no responsibility.
You hit me and stumbled backward yourself.
My shadow touched you first.
That was not an attack, not yet.
I stand still, waiting for you to try again.
The Watcher has no mate.
I follow you, and no one else.
I am the only one in this forest.
Breed? I breed only fear.
The place beside you is empty.
I need no kin to keep me company.
The night is crowded enough already.

lines.zh: 两个注视者会互相看着
lines.en: Two Watchers would only stare at each other.
I guard this path alone.
Do not find me company; I dislike noise.
Nothing lying on the ground is worth my hands.
The sword you dropped can wait until morning.
I have no pockets and no need for them.

lines.zh: 你的掉落物我不感兴趣
lines.en: Your dropped items do not interest me.
I only want you still standing.
That iron rusts beside my foot.
Picking it up will not help; run.
A stone rolled over; I kicked it away.
The only thing I collect is your time.
Do not bend down; that is dangerous.

lines.zh: 你进了我的视野，就这样
lines.en: You entered my sight; that is all it took.
Nine points of damage; enough to remember me.

lines.zh: 我挑中你，因为你最靠近
lines.en: I chose you because you were nearest.
Your torch went out; now we begin.
You snapped a twig, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命，你来试
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health; come and try.

lines.zh: 百层护甲，你的箭会弹开
lines.en: A hundred armor; your arrows will bounce off.
Prey confirmed, and the route is set.
Your footsteps are a song I now know by heart.
From this moment, you will not sleep.

lines.zh: 你回头那一下，我等很久了
lines.en: I waited a long time for you to turn.
The sound of your door closing was lovely.

lines.zh: 你选了这条路，我选的你
lines.en: You chose this road; I chose you.
Do not count the distance; it will not help.

lines.zh: 你举弓的姿势，我记下了
lines.en: I have noted the way you raise that bow.

lines.zh: 这一夜由我点名，就是你
lines.en: I am calling names tonight, and yours comes up.
I keep your pace, never quicker, never slower.

lines.zh: 你跑进村子，我停在栅栏外
lines.en: You run into the village; I stop at the fence.
You change direction; I change with you.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比你的体力长
lines.en: Your legs will tire long before my patience does.
You circled three times; I am still here.
Water does not block my sight.

lines.zh: 你藏在矿洞里，我数着格子
lines.en: You hide in a mine; I count the blocks.
The farther you run, the louder you breathe.
The gap under your door is far too wide.

lines.zh: 你在等天亮，我在等你累
lines.en: You wait for dawn; I wait for you to tire.
I will not lose you.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在泥里很清楚
lines.en: Your footprints show clearly in the mud.

lines.zh: 九点伤害只需要一下时机
lines.en: Nine damage needs only one good moment.
Listen; I am right behind you.

lines.zh: 你跑过三条街，我一步没落
lines.en: Three streets down, and I have not lost a step.

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我偏在前面
lines.en: When you glanced back, I was ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我把距离缩短到一臂之长
lines.en: I am closing the gap to one arm's length.

lines.zh: 火把那头，有我的呼吸声
lines.en: Past the torchlight, that breathing is mine.

lines.zh: 你在楼梯上，我守楼梯口
lines.en: You are on the stairs. I hold the bottom.
Count the steps. Each one brings you closer.

lines.zh: 我的手落下来，像门关上
lines.en: My hand comes down like a closing door.
Nine damage, and you fell back two steps.

lines.zh: 你的护甲在我指下裂开
lines.en: Your armor cracks beneath my fingers.
Do not block it; you cannot.

lines.zh: 这一下是提醒，不是结束
lines.en: This blow is a reminder, not the end.
Blood drips onto the grass, loudly.

lines.zh: 我打你只用手，不用武器
lines.en: I strike with bare hands, no weapon at all.

lines.zh: 你倒在地上的样子我见过
lines.en: I have seen you lying on the ground before.
Again; I am keeping count.
Your shield stopped only half of it.

lines.zh: 疼是好事，说明你还活着
lines.en: Pain is good; it means you still live.
I am in no hurry; I have the whole night.
This palm print will stay on your shoulder.
Run; I will let you go first.

lines.zh: 我的手划过，墙上多了血色
lines.en: My hand passes, and the wall takes on color.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，只是让你记住
lines.en: That was light. It was only meant to be remembered.

lines.zh: 我在你没点灯的角落成形
lines.en: I take shape in the corner you left unlit.
Night falls, and I am standing here.
First the trees go quiet, and then me.

lines.zh: 你的火把抖了一下，我来了
lines.en: Your torch flickered once; I arrived.

lines.zh: 我从你视野边缘走进来
lines.en: I step in from the edge of your sight.

lines.zh: 一千零二十四点生命落地
lines.en: One thousand and twenty-four health touches down.

lines.zh: 百层护甲在月光下变黑
lines.en: A hundred armor plates darken in moonlight.
No footsteps, only a shadow.

lines.zh: 我可以等，时间对我无所谓
lines.en: I can wait; time means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 门外的雾散开，我在这里
lines.en: The fog outside your door clears; here I am.
This forest belongs to me tonight.

lines.zh: 你听见的第一声呼吸是我
lines.en: The first breath you hear is mine.
I rise slowly out of the ground.
Do not look for a way out; I am it.

lines.zh: 这片林子的雾今晚有了形状
lines.en: Tonight the fog in these woods has a shape.

lines.zh: 我从树与树之间慢慢显出来
lines.en: I ease out from between the trees.

lines.zh: 你在营地里，我停在营地外
lines.en: You keep to your camp. I stay just outside it.

lines.zh: 月亮到最高处时，我落地了
lines.en: When the moon reached its height, I arrived.

lines.zh: 没有雷声，只有我站在这里
lines.en: No thunder. Only me, standing here.
I do not come quickly, but I always arrive.
The fire only warms my armor plates.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我站得更直
lines.en: I fall from a height and stand straighter.

lines.zh: 水灌不进注视者的喉咙
lines.en: Water cannot fill the Watcher's throat.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀开，我又走回来
lines.en: The blast throws me aside; I walk back.
The arrow sticks in my armor like a thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法在我身上散得很慢
lines.en: Magic disperses slowly across my body.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，也不会饿死
lines.en: I eat nothing and never starve.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身上，我记住了
lines.en: Lightning struck me; I will remember it.
Even in the void, I am watching you.
